user.title: Connect to Scrypted Stamina
user.description: The Stamina plugin's endpoint in Scrypted, and the token from the plugin's settings.

data_description.url: The Integration URL from the plugin's settings. When Scrypted runs on this host, http://127.0.0.1:11080/endpoint/@marl1w/scrypted-stamina/public needs no certificate. For another host use its https URL; the certificate is then shown for you to accept.
data_description.verify_ssl: Scrypted uses a self-signed certificate, so leave this off unless you gave it a real one.

reauth_confirm.title: New token
reauth_confirm.description: The Stamina plugin refused the token, or presented a different certificate (changed: {changed}). Paste the current token from the plugin's settings. Certificate SHA-256: {fingerprint}.

certificate.title: Accept the plugin's certificate
certificate.description:
Scrypted uses a self-signed certificate. Check that this SHA-256 fingerprint is the one Scrypted shows, then accept it; it is pinned, and a different certificate will be refused.

{fingerprint}

error.cannot_connect: The plugin did not answer at that URL.
error.insecure_url: Plain http is only allowed to this machine (127.0.0.1). Use the plugin's https URL.
error.certificate_changed: The plugin now presents a different certificate. Check the new fingerprint below before accepting it.

abort.already_configured: Scrypted Stamina is already set up.

user.title: Add a destination
user.description: Every kept event goes to every destination. Choose from the storage integrations already set up.

data_description.orphan_retention_days: Orphaned events (kept because no decision could be made) are never removed for room, only after this many days.
data_description.folder: Events go to pending/, events/ and unusual-unconfirmed/ under this folder, one subfolder per area.
data_description.quota_gb: When full, the oldest committed events are removed first. Pending and orphaned events are never removed.
data_description.retention_days: Remove committed events older than this. 0 keeps them until the quota needs the room.
data_description.follow_up_cap_gb: Vetoed events wait in pending/ during the follow-up window. Above this, the oldest of them are dropped early.

abort.no_destination: No storage integration is set up, or each is already a destination. Set up Synology DSM, WebDAV, SFTP Storage, OneDrive or Google Drive first.

data.relevance_sensitivity: How much to flag as unusual
data.unverified_min_seconds: Without a verifier, keep subjects seen for at least
data.unverified_min_score: Without a verifier, keep subjects scoring at least

data_description.upload_classes: Ordinary events with a confirmed subject of one of these classes are kept while Uploads is on 'Chosen classes'. Unusual events are kept whatever their class.
data_description.history_size_mb: Room for the event history the model learns from. When it is full, routine dropped events are thinned out; kept and unusual events are never removed.

camera.title: {camera}
camera.description: Entities whose state is recorded with every event of this camera, and whose changes after an event count as late evidence. Empty until you add some.

over_quota.title: {destination} is over its quota
over_quota.description: Pending footage could not fit inside the quota of {destination}, and no committed event was left to remove for room. The footage was uploaded anyway, over the quota. Raise the quota, or free space on the destination.
